faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins is 100 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $2.95/pc (100 pcs starter tier), $1.88/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.35/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins is $110 Mold (Waived @ 1,000+ pcs). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins is custom-engineered from Reinforced 4mm Zinc Alloy using Double-Sided Coin Relief + Integrated Opener Slot, sized around Ø54×4.0mm (2.15") at approximately 64g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Antique Silver / Copper / Black Nickel. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with PVC Pouch / Custom Backing Card. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins completes in 10–14 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Bottle Opener Challenge Coins can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
